events.title: 노나라 남무성에서 태어나다
events.title_en: Born in Nanwucheng, State of Lu
events.description: 노나라 남무성에서 태어났다. 아버지 증점도 공자의 제자였다.
events.description_en: He was born in Nanwucheng in the state of Lu. His father, Zeng Dian, was also a disciple of Confucius.

events.title: 공자의 문하에 들어가다
events.description: 아버지를 따라 공자의 제자가 되었다. 공자보다 마흔여섯 살 어렸다.
events.description_en: Following his father, he became a disciple of Confucius. He was forty-six years younger than his teacher.

events.title: 하루 세 번 자신을 살피다
events.title_en: He examined himself three times a day
events.description: 날마다 세 번 스스로를 돌아본다고 말했다. 남을 위해 일할 때 정성을 다했는지, 벗과 사귈 때 믿음을 지켰는지, 배운 것을 익혔는지를 물었다.
events.description_en: He said he examined himself three times each day. He asked whether he had given his best in work for others, kept faith with friends, and practiced what he had learned.

events.title: 아내가 아이에게 한 약속을 지키려 돼지를 잡다
events.title_en: He slaughtered a pig to keep a promise made to his child
events.description: 아내가 아이를 달래려 장에 다녀오면 돼지를 잡아 주겠다고 무심코 말했다. 증자는 그 말을 지켜 돼지를 잡았고, 아이 앞에서 거짓말하면 안 된다고 했다.
events.description_en: His wife had carelessly told their child she would kill a pig for him if he stopped crying. Zengzi kept her word and slaughtered the pig, saying a parent must never lie in front of a child.

events.title: 공자가 죽은 뒤 제자를 모아 가르치다
events.title_en: After Confucius died he gathered his own students
events.description: 공자가 세상을 뜬 뒤 제자를 모아 가르쳤다. 공자의 손자 자사가 그 문하에서 배웠다.
events.description_en: After Confucius died he gathered students of his own and taught them. Confucius's grandson, Zisi, studied under him.

events.title: 효경을 짓다
events.title_en: He is said to have composed the Xiaojing
events.description: 효를 다룬 효경이 그의 저작으로 전한다. 스승 공자가 전한 가르침을 제자들이 정리했다는 설도 있다.
events.description_en: The Xiaojing, a classic on filial piety, is traditionally attributed to him. Some accounts say his own students compiled it from what Confucius had taught him.

events.title: 자리를 바꾸게 하고 죽다
events.title_en: He had his mat changed before he died
events.description: 병으로 누워 있을 때 제자가 깔개가 대부의 것이라 알렸다. 예에 어긋난다며 기어이 자리를 바꾸게 한 뒤 숨을 거두었다.
events.description_en: As he lay dying, a student told him the mat beneath him belonged to a nobleman. He insisted it be changed, since it broke the rites, and died only after it was replaced.
